macros.name: cmnum
macros.doc: The command \cmnum switches back to Arabic numerals.

macros.name: dn
macros.doc: The basic delimiter is the \dn macro. This delimiter is used by enclosing Devanāgarı̄ text between {\dn ... }, eg. {\dn acchaa}.

macros.name: dnnum
macros.doc: The command \dnnum switches to Devanāgarı̄ numerals.
